title: Jio Payment Bank Account Opening: Steps, Fees and Earnings
summary: Jio Payment Bank account opening in 2026: steps, documents, zero balance rules, charges, the ₹2 lakh limit, and how partners earn by opening accounts for others.
body_markdown:
Jio Payment Bank account opening takes a few minutes on the JioFinance or MyJio app, or at a Jio Payments Bank outlet. Any Indian resident above 18 can apply with an Aadhaar number, a PAN card and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. The account is zero balance and pays interest of up to 4% a year (Jio Payments Bank FAQs, retrieved 2026-11-25). Balances are capped at ₹2 lakh per customer by RBI rules.


**GroMo** is a free app where partners earn commission by helping customers open bank accounts and apply for cards and loans. For each Jio Payments Bank account, the GroMo app shows up to ₹200, with a base payout of ₹100 (GroMo product catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-25). Part one covers opening your own account. Part two covers how to earn from it.


## Jio Payments Bank Savings Account: Quick Facts


Point Detail


Who can open Any Indian resident above 18 years of age


Documents Aadhaar number and a physical PAN card


Mobile number Any number linked to your Aadhaar; a Jio number is not needed


Where to open JioFinance app, MyJio app or a Jio Payments Bank outlet


Minimum balance None, and no initial deposit


Interest Up to 4% a year, paid quarterly (rate effective 16 January 2026)


Debit card RuPay Platinum debit card, chosen while opening or later


Maximum balance ₹2 lakh per customer as an end-of-day balance (RBI rule for payments banks)


Joint account Not available


Loans or credit cards Not allowed for payments banks


Sources: Jio Payments Bank FAQs and JioFinance savings account page, read 25 November 2026; RBI circular of 8 April 2021.


## How Does Jio Payment Bank Account Opening Work Online?


Jio Payment Bank account opening happens online in the JioFinance app or the MyJio app, under the Bank tab. The bank's FAQ lists these two apps and its banking outlets as the ways to open an account. On the app, the journey asks for your Aadhaar and PAN details, verifies your mobile number, completes KYC and lets you pick the account variant and debit card. The JioFinance guide to video KYC says a live video session usually takes 5 to 10 minutes and needs Aadhaar, PAN, a phone camera and stable internet (JioFinance, read 25 November 2026). Screens change often, so follow what the app shows on the day.


1. Install the JioFinance app (or open MyJio) and log in with the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar.
2. Go to the Bank tab and choose to open a savings account.
3. Enter your Aadhaar and PAN details and confirm the OTP.
4. Complete KYC as the app asks, which can include a short video call where you show your PAN.
5. Choose your account variant and debit card, then set your MPIN.
6. Note your account number, IFSC and UPI handle from the app once the account is active.


People without a smartphone can still bank with Jio Payments Bank. The FAQ says customers can visit any banking outlet, where transactions are confirmed with a fingerprint.


## What Documents and Eligibility Do You Need?


Jio Payments Bank needs only two documents for a savings account: your Aadhaar number and a physical copy of your PAN card. The bank's FAQ says PAN is currently mandatory, so a person without PAN cannot open this savings account yet. You must be an Indian resident above 18 years of age. Your mobile number does not have to be a Jio number, but it must be linked to your Aadhaar, because the OTP goes to that number (Jio Payments Bank FAQs, read 25 November 2026).


Three checks save time before you start:


- **Name match:** your name should read the same way on Aadhaar and PAN, or KYC may stall.
- **Aadhaar mobile link:** if your number is not linked, update it at an Aadhaar centre first.
- **PAN in hand:** keep the physical card ready, since a video KYC officer may ask you to show it on camera.


KYC is the identity check every bank must do under RBI rules. Our guide to the[KYC full form and process](https://gromo.in/blog/kyc-full-form/) explains what the bank verifies and why.


## Is Jio Payments Bank Zero Balance, and What Are the Charges?


Yes, a Jio Payments Bank savings account is a zero balance account. The bank's FAQ says there is no minimum balance requirement and no initial deposit to open the account. The GroMo product page also lists no account maintenance charges (GroMo product catalogue, 25 November 2026). Monthly email statements are free, while a physical statement costs a nominal fee. UPI money transfers and merchant payments carry no charge, though the bank notes that NPCI rules can change this (Jio Payments Bank FAQs, read 25 November 2026).


Item What the bank says


Minimum balance None


Initial deposit None


Account maintenance No charge listed on the GroMo product page


Email statement Free, monthly


Physical statement Nominal charge on request


UPI transfers No charge at present


Debit card and ATM fees Listed in the bank's Schedule of Service Charges


Interest Up to 4% a year, paid quarterly


Debit card issuance, annual card fees and ATM charges are published in the bank's Schedule of Service Charges, last revised on 15 November 2026 according to the Jio Payments Bank website. Check that schedule in the app or on the bank's site before you choose a card variant. The GroMo product page says the top interest rate applies on balances above ₹1 lakh. Compare this with other options in our guide to[zero balance savings accounts](https://gromo.in/blog/zero-balance-savings-account/) .


## What Are the Limits of a Payments Bank Account?


A payments bank is a smaller kind of bank licensed by the RBI for deposits and payments, not for lending. Under the RBI licensing guidelines of 27 November 2014, a payments bank "cannot undertake lending activities" and "cannot issue credit cards", though it can issue ATM and debit cards. The maximum balance was raised from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh per individual customer as an end-of-day balance by the[RBI circular of 8 April 2021](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=12074&Mode=0&ref=gromo.in) , with immediate effect.


For a Jio Payments Bank customer, this means:


- **Balance cap:** money above the limit does not stay in the account. Balances above ₹1,95,000 move automatically to a sweep account with Suryoday Small Finance Bank (GroMo product catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-25).
- **No loans:** you cannot borrow from Jio Payments Bank itself.
- **No credit card:** the account comes with a debit card only.
- **No joint account:** the bank does not offer joint accounts at present.


The account works best as a daily payments and savings account rather than a place for large balances.


## Is Jio Payments Bank Safe?


Jio Payments Bank is a bank licensed by the Reserve Bank of India and states on its website that it is registered with DICGC, the RBI body that protects bank deposits. The RBI's 2014 guidelines say deposits in payments banks are protected under the DICGC scheme. DICGC protects deposits up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank (DICGC FAQs, retrieved 25 November 2026). On the app, the account is protected by a password and MPIN; at outlets, the customer confirms each transaction with a fingerprint (Jio Payments Bank FAQs, read 25 November 2026).


Two habits keep the account safe:


- Never share your MPIN, OTP or card PIN, including with anyone who says they are from the bank.
- Set a daily card limit under card controls in the JioFinance or MyJio app.


Lounge access on the Jio RuPay Platinum debit card ended on 1 April 2026, so ignore any offer that still promises it.


## How Can You Earn by Opening Jio Payments Bank Accounts for Others?


You earn by sharing a Jio Payments Bank link from the GroMo app with people who want a zero balance account. The customer opens the account on their own phone through that link, and the bank decides whether the account is complete. When the account meets the product's terms, the payout reaches your GroMo wallet. Joining GroMo is free, and you need an Android phone, a PAN card and a bank account in your own name, as our guide to[who can earn money with GroMo](https://gromo.in/blog/who-can-earn-with-gromo/) explains.


Savings accounts are often the easiest first product for a new partner because the customer pays nothing and needs no credit check.


The steps for a partner:


1. Install the GroMo app and complete your partner registration.
2. Open the Saving Account section and select Jio Payments Bank.
3. Read the product page: benefits, payout and the conditions for a successful account.
4. Share your link with the customer on WhatsApp or in person.
5. Help the customer keep Aadhaar and PAN ready, then let them complete KYC themselves.
6. Track the status in the app until the payout is credited.


Never fill in a form on the customer's behalf or ask for their OTP or MPIN. The customer must complete their own KYC.


## How Much Does GroMo Pay per Savings Account?


GroMo pays a fixed amount per successful account, and the amount differs by bank. For Jio Payments Bank, the app label shows up to ₹200 and the base payout is ₹100 (GroMo product catalogue, 25 November 2026). Partners who meet different customers can offer more than one account and match each customer to the right bank. The table lists the savings accounts in the GroMo app on 25 November 2026.

> **Please note:** Payouts are set by GroMo and its banking partners and can change at any time. A payout is paid only when the bank confirms the account as complete under the product's terms shown in the app. The "up to" figure is the highest amount the app shows, not what every account earns. Check the live payout in the app before you share a link.


Our post on[savings account refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/saving-account-refer-and-earn/) compares how bank referral programs pay against partner payouts.


## Who Can Earn the Most from Account Opening?


The people who earn the most from account opening already meet many customers who need a basic bank account. Account opening works best where customers trust the person helping them and need an account for UPI, salary or government transfers. Three groups fit especially well:


Who Why account opening fits Who they usually help


Shopkeepers and mobile recharge shops Customers visit daily and already ask for help with phones and payments Walk-in customers, workers, small traders


Students Large friend circles, many friends still without a full KYC bank account Classmates, hostel mates, family


Rural helpers and CSC operators Many people in villages want a simple account on their phone Farmers, homemakers, daily wage workers


Shop owners who already work as banking correspondents can add digital accounts to their counter work; our guide to[Bank Mitra and CSP work](https://gromo.in/blog/bank-mitra-csp/) covers that role. Account opening also gives a partner a first conversation that can later lead to other products, when a customer needs them.


## Why Do Account Openings Fail, and How Can You Avoid It?


Most failed account openings stop at KYC, not at the link. The Jio Payments Bank FAQ makes PAN mandatory and requires a mobile number linked to Aadhaar, so a customer missing either cannot finish. The applicant must also be above 18. Video KYC needs a working camera and stable internet, and a session can drop on a weak signal. A partner who checks these points before sharing the link avoids most failed attempts (Jio Payments Bank FAQs and JioFinance, read 25 November 2026).


Reason an application stalls What to check first


No PAN card PAN is mandatory; the customer should get PAN first


Mobile not linked to Aadhaar Update the mobile number at an Aadhaar centre


Customer under 18 Not eligible for this account


Name differs on PAN and Aadhaar Correct the record before applying


Video KYC dropped Retry in good light with a stable connection


Customer opened through another link Make sure the customer uses your GroMo link from the start


Another common reason a partner misses a payout is an account that is opened but not completed under the product's terms. Read the conditions on the product page in the GroMo app before you share the link.


## How Much Could a Part-Time Partner Earn? A Simple Example


Here is a simple worked example. Priya runs a mobile recharge counter in a small town. Over one month, 15 of her customers open a Jio Payments Bank account through her GroMo link. Every account meets the product's terms.


She is paid the base payout for each completed account. The month adds up like this:


Completed accounts Base payout per account Total for the month


15 ₹100 ₹1,500


Small numbers, yes. But a busy counter sees many customers, and some later ask for a card or a loan.


**This example is illustrative only. It is not typical and is not guaranteed.** Real earnings depend on how many customers complete their accounts, which accounts they choose and the payouts live in the app on the day. Some months will be lower.


## Frequently Asked Questions


Short answers to the questions people ask most about Jio Payments Bank accounts and partner payouts.


### Can I open a Jio Payments Bank account without a Jio SIM?


Yes. The bank's FAQ says you can open the account with any mobile number, as long as that number is linked to your Aadhaar. You can also create a Jio UPI handle with any Indian mobile number.


### Is PAN card mandatory for Jio Payments Bank account opening?


Yes. Jio Payments Bank currently requires a PAN card to open a savings account, along with your Aadhaar number.


### What is the minimum balance in Jio Payments Bank?


There is no minimum balance requirement and no initial deposit for a Jio Payments Bank savings account.


### What is the Jio Payments Bank interest rate?


The bank pays interest of up to 4% a year, credited quarterly, on savings account balances, effective 16 January 2026. The GroMo product page says the top rate applies on balances above ₹1 lakh.


### How much money can I keep in a Jio Payments Bank account?


An RBI rule limits payments banks to a balance of ₹2 lakh per individual customer as an end-of-day balance. Balances above ₹1,95,000 sweep to Suryoday Small Finance Bank (GroMo product catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-25).


### Can I get a loan or credit card from Jio Payments Bank?


No. RBI rules do not allow payments banks to lend or issue credit cards. You get a debit card with the account.


### How much does GroMo pay for a Jio Payments Bank account?


The GroMo app shows up to ₹200 per successful Jio Payments Bank account, with a base payout of ₹100, as of 25 November 2026. Payouts change, so check the app. Before you join, read our answer on[whether GroMo is real or fake](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) .


## Disclosures


GroMo (Vitrak Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a distribution platform. GroMo is not a bank and does not hold customer deposits. Savings accounts are offered by RBI-licensed banks, which alone decide account opening, KYC, interest rates and charges. Jio Payments Bank Limited is the bank for the account described here.


Partner earnings depend on effort, the number of customers who complete their accounts, and the payouts live in the app. Any figures shown are illustrative examples. They are not typical and are not guaranteed. GroMo does not guarantee any level of income.


## Disclaimer


The information on this page is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice. Bank features, interest rates and charges can change; check the current terms in the JioFinance app or on the Jio Payments Bank website before opening an account. RBI rules summarised here may change; read the current rules on the RBI website. You must be 18 or older to join GroMo.
